speaker: josias_thwaite
text: All Saints. One glass. The wardens have spoken to me, and I am keeping their length.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One glass, sir. I will not ask you for a second.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: A cloud of witnesses, to be followed. Not sued to. That is the sermon. I will not say it a second way to make it warmer.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Followed, and not sued to. A Christian can walk home on that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not come to add a name to a book.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The book has its saints. I am not writing a feast the wardens have already shortened.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nor at supper. A house can keep a memory without a second pulpit.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The horn is at home, sir. Today is not the day she boils it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Today is the feast. The ink can keep its Monday.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: You are looked for at two. I will not hold the porch past the glass.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the glass. Errors at two. I am not carrying a longer sermon up the lane.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Errors at two. God give you a clean old man, and bring you back for evening prayer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Egeon, at both ends. Evening prayer is on the book. I will be there.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sir John is in his pew, and he has not spoken. There is no sword-bearer at the end of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I saw the pew. I am not waiting on a word from him. He never gave me one.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: He may sit a Christian among Christians. I am not asking him for a speech, and I am not giving him one of mine.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The great house was dark in its upper window when I came across. No halberds at the gate.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That began on Wednesday. We are not making a procession of it on a feast morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not been down to the gate. I am not going down to it from this porch.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then leave the gate. The glass is the work. A cloud of witnesses, to be followed. Not sued to.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have said it once, Master Thwaite. Once is what the wardens bought.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Once. I will not say it again at evening prayer to fill the hour. God give you the day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you, sir.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Dinner is on the board at home, sir, if you are in before the lane.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a penny, and it is a full thumb short of the notch. I am not measuring it twice on a feast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, and a thumb. I will not argue a thumb. I will eat, and I will go.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Go, then. The porch has had its glass.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Come across. Alse, do not collect a conversation between here and the door.
